main.summary: Provides deterministic token-scoped blob names for one tenant transfer session and its item-instance artifacts.

property.name: SessionID
property.summary: Transfer session identifier used to namespace the staging paths.

property.name: ItemInstanceToken
property.summary: Catalog-owned item instance token used to isolate artifacts from other instances.

property.name: Prefix
property.summary: Virtual blob prefix for one item instance and session in the form instances/{itemInstanceToken}/transfers/{session}.

property.name: InstancePrefix
property.summary: Virtual blob prefix containing all artifacts for this item instance.

property.name: ObjectName
property.summary: Blob name for the staged serialized object payload.

property.name: PublishedObjectName
property.summary: Token-scoped final serialized object blob name.

property.name: PublishedIntegrityName
property.summary: Token-scoped final integrity metadata blob name.

method.name: ForInstance
method.summary: Creates deterministic paths scoped to an item instance, independent of any transfer session.

method.name: Create
method.summary: Create deterministic paths for one item instance and transfer session.

method.name: CreateRangeName
method.summary: Create the blob name for a staged logical segmented-transfer range.

method.name: CreateChunkName
method.summary: Create the blob name for a staged stream operation chunk.

method.name: CreatePublicationObjectName
method.summary: Create the blob name for a publication operation's staged final object.
method.param: Publication operation identifier; must not be empty.

method.name: CreatePrefix
method.summary: Create the deterministic virtual blob prefix for an item instance and transfer session.

method.name: ValidateIdentity
method.summary: Validate that the item instance token and transfer session identifier are present.

method.name: ValidateOperationID
method.summary: Validate that a transfer operation identifier is present.

main.summary: Provides deterministic published artifact names scoped to one catalog-owned item instance.

property.name: ItemInstanceToken
property.summary: Catalog-owned item instance token used to isolate artifacts from other instances.

property.name: Prefix
property.summary: Virtual blob prefix containing all artifacts for this item instance.

property.name: PublishedObjectName
property.summary: Token-scoped final serialized object blob name.

property.name: PublishedIntegrityName
property.summary: Token-scoped final integrity metadata blob name.

method.name: Create
method.summary: Creates token-scoped paths after validating the item instance token.
method.param: Catalog-owned item instance token; must not be empty.
method.exception: The item instance token is empty.
